_comment: T1.3 (spec 674) ratchet for prose-tier cross-skill references. Blocking-tier refs are never baselined - they fail outright. This number may only go DOWN; raising it requires a deliberate commit that says why.
_history: 90 -> 122 on 2026-07-30 when the prose tier was widened from code-spans-only to every markup form a skill body actually uses (bold, italic, links, angle brackets), and fenced-code hits were demoted into this tier rather than discarded. Not a regression: the same references were always there, the earlier detector could not see them. 120 -> 133 on 2026-07-31 when main's adversarial-design-loop plugin (#674) merged in: six skills that cross-reference each other in prose. Attributed, not assumed - the same tree with those six directories removed still measures exactly 120, and blocking stayed at 35 across the merge. 133 -> 87 and 35 -> 0 on 2026-08-08: T1.1's remediation and the #700 skill rewrite landed, and the ceiling had been sitting 46 warnings and 35 blocking sites above reality - a ratchet that far above the measurement cannot catch a regression, which is the only thing it exists to do. 87 -> 100 on 2026-08-18: Domain bundle consolidation (adversarial-design-loop into stitch-design, manifest-docker into manifest-ops) and addition of Phase 2 router skills (refactor, shell-audit, issue-manage, pr-manage); blocking maintained at 0.
_blocking_note: 0 is the intended posture: every blocking reference has been rewritten to the qualified form, so any new one fails the build outright. The temporary 35-site tolerance that let this gate enter CI without turning unrelated PRs red is retired. Do not raise it.
_sites_note: Pins WHICH references are tolerated, not just how many. A count-only ratchet cannot see a SWAP - remove one blocking reference, add a different one, total unchanged, brand new silent-failure site admitted. Any site not on this list fails, and the list is now empty: no blocking reference is tolerated anywhere.
